xmldoc.short_description: Create or select an axes with two y-axes.

param_input_item.param_description: Activate the left side. New plots are added to the left y-axis.
Activate the right side. New plots are added to the right y-axis.

description.p: The two sides share the same x-axis but each has its own limits, colour, scale, direction, ticks, label and children. Properties whose name starts with Y (such as YLim, YColor or YLabel) apply to the active side only. Query YAxisLocation to know which side is active.
By default the left ruler uses the first colour of the axes ColorOrder and the right ruler the second colour.
The two rulers are also available as objects through the axes YAxis property: YAxis(1) is the left ruler and YAxis(2) the right ruler, whatever the active side.
cla reset removes the second y-axis and returns to a single y-axis.

example_item.example_item_data: f = figure(); x = linspace(0, 10); yyaxis left plot(x, sin(x)) ylabel('left side') yyaxis right plot(x, 100 * cos(x)) ylabel('right side')
